name: repotrail
description: Agent-authored JSON codebase tours in VS Code.

commands.title: RepoTrail: Copy Tour From Here Prompt
RepoTrail: Jump to Current Step Code

enumDescriptions: On startup, ask whether to resume the most recent tour for this workspace.
Silently restore the most recent tour on startup.
repoTrail.autoResume.description: What to do with the most recently active tour when VS Code opens this workspace. RepoTrail keeps a small local progress record so a window reload does not lose your place.

enumDescriptions: Local Kokoro-82M neural voice (experimental). Free and natural; runs in a background Web Worker via WASM and downloads a ~80MB model on first use. Inference is CPU-heavy and slow on some machines — falls back to the system voice if it stalls.
Browser SpeechSynthesis using native OS voices. Free, instant, works offline. Robotic but reliable — the default.
Shell out to a system command (macOS `say`; override via repoTrail.tts.command on Linux).
ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 — natural hosted voice with low latency. Requires repoTrail.tts.elevenLabsApiKey.
OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts — natural, tone-steerable hosted voice. Requires repoTrail.tts.openAiApiKey.
repoTrail.tts.provider.markdownDescription: Which engine reads tour narration aloud. **system** (default) uses free native OS voices — instant and reliable. **kokoro** is a free, natural neural voice that runs locally in a background worker, but model load/inference is CPU-heavy (experimental). **say** shells out to a command. **elevenlabs**/**openai** are hosted neural voices that need an API key.

repoTrail.tts.command.description: Command invoked when repoTrail.tts.provider is 'say'. The narration text is passed as a single argv[1]. Use `espeak` or `spd-say` on Linux.

repoTrail.tts.kokoroVoice.description: Kokoro voice id used when repoTrail.tts.provider is 'kokoro' (e.g. af_heart, af_bella, af_nicole, am_michael, am_adam, bf_emma, bm_george).

repoTrail.tts.elevenLabsApiKey.markdownDescription: ElevenLabs API key, used when provider is 'elevenlabs'. Falls back to the `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` env var. Prefer the env var or secret storage over committing a key.

repoTrail.tts.elevenLabsModel.description: ElevenLabs model id. eleven_flash_v2_5 is the low-latency default; eleven_multilingual_v2 is higher quality but slower and pricier.

repoTrail.tts.openAiApiKey.markdownDescription: OpenAI API key, used when provider is 'openai'. Falls back to the `OPENAI_API_KEY` env var.

repoTrail.tts.openAiModel.description: OpenAI TTS model. gpt-4o-mini-tts is steerable (honors openAiInstructions) and recommended for code review. Use tts-1 or tts-1-hd if your key/project lacks access to gpt-4o-mini-tts.

repoTrail.tts.openAiVoice.description: OpenAI TTS voice. For reading code review feedback, calm/clear voices work best: ash, sage, alloy. (Also: ballad, coral, echo, shimmer, verse.)

repoTrail.tts.openAiInstructions.default: Read this code walkthrough aloud like a friendly senior engineer pair-programming: clear, calm, with natural pacing.
repoTrail.tts.openAiInstructions.description: Tone/style instructions passed to gpt-4o-mini-tts. Only the gpt-4o-mini-tts model honors this.

scripts.test: sh -c 'rm -rf out-test && tsc -p ./ --outDir out-test && node --test test/*.test.mjs; status=$?; rm -rf out-test; exit $status'
